purpose: Read-only source overlays for the bounded IcePop probability APIs used by prime-rl #4176

renderers.commit_subject: perf: return completion logprobs as a float32 array (#201)
feature_evidence: renderers/client.py::_parse_compact_logprobs parses bounded compact sampled-token and top-k logprobs

verifiers.commit_subject: fix: scope run sampling to the run's client (#2973)
feature_evidence: verifiers/v1/clients/train.py maps completion_top_ids and completion_top_logprobs into TopLogprobs
verifiers/v1/trace.py exposes branch-aligned sampling_mask and top_logprobs views

selection: Exact gitlinks recorded by prime-rl commit 735496e36fc9cb82e94b50098841bb80b2a0aaa1 (#4176), rather than the older #4012 pins.

validation.command: ulimit -v 2097152; PYTHONPATH=<overlay-renderers>:<overlay-verifiers> uv run --offline --no-project --python .venv/bin/python python -c 'from renderers.client import _parse_compact_logprobs; from verifiers.v1 import SamplingMask, TopLogprobs; from verifiers.v1.trace import Trace, MessageNode'
validation.scope: source imports only; no dependency installation, package build, or GPU work

dependency_notes: The bare offline system interpreter lacks pydantic and cannot import renderers; the existing prime-rl .venv has pydantic 2.13.4 and the requested API imports pass there.

verifiers.v1.SamplingMask intentionally carries ids/counts only at the upstream API boundary. The prime-rl #4176 transport SamplingMask.logprobs is assembled downstream from its paired bounded-support evidence; no verifier overlay patch was made.
